slot.brief: Identify shapes of simple species like ClF3 / SO2 / NH3 from VSEPR lone-pair counting; pick correct shape set from options.

stem: Which option gives the shapes of $\text{ClF}_3$, $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{NH}_3$, respectively?

verdicts.working: VSEPR: ClF₃ is T-shaped (AX₃E₂), SO₂ is bent, and NH₃ is trigonal pyramidal.

working:
$\text{ClF}_3$: $AX_3E_2$, T-shaped
$\text{SO}_2$: $AX_2E$, bent
$\text{NH}_3$: $AX_3E$, trigonal pyramidal Independent check: VSEPR: ClF₃ is T-shaped (AX₃E₂), SO₂ is bent, and NH₃ is trigonal pyramidal.
solution: By VSEPR theory, $\text{ClF}_3$ is $AX_3E_2$ and T-shaped, $\text{SO}_2$ is $AX_2E$ and bent, while $\text{NH}_3$ is $AX_3E$ and trigonal pyramidal.
